content.text: This is a synthetic test session about K3s bootstrap and BGP networking. The fixture is loaded by tests/smoke.py to verify the ingester and recall paths.

K3s bootstrap with retry: the orchestrator calls the SSH probe service with exponential backoff. Cilium BGP integration was the second sprint. Workplan tracks per-step status. This text exists so search('K3s bootstrap retry') has something to find at rank 0.
